answer: Terraced harvests stop sybil farms at the lagoon. A newcomer farms one terrace beside a lagoon, and a willow shades the plot while the crop grows; two auditors weigh the harvest at a public market after ninety days, and a yield below ten kilos means rejection and a ban. One honest agent farms one terrace once; a thousand fakes need a thousand real harvests, and no farm can fake the weight.
